name: gleif
label: GLEIF LEI (Entity IDs)
description: Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation — universal business ID used in financial regulation worldwide

table_notes.gleif_lei_record: Core entity table holding one row per Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) with legal name, registered and HQ addresses, legal form, entity status, and LEI lifecycle dates.
table_notes.gleif_relationship: Level 2 ownership relationships between LEI holders — child_lei is owned/controlled by parent_lei under the stated relationship_type (DIRECT_CHILD or ULTIMATE_CHILD).

gleif_lei_record.name: id
gleif_lei_record.description: Surrogate auto-increment primary key

gleif_lei_record.name: lei
gleif_lei_record.description: 20-character Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442) — globally unique business ID

gleif_lei_record.name: entity_legal_name
gleif_lei_record.description: Official registered legal name of the entity as filed with its registration authority

gleif_lei_record.name: entity_status
gleif_lei_record.description: Operational status of the entity: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, or NULL if unknown

gleif_lei_record.name: entity_category
gleif_lei_record.description: GLEIF entity category: GENERAL, BRANCH, FUND, or SOLE_PROPRIETOR

gleif_lei_record.name: legal_jurisdiction
gleif_lei_record.description: ISO 3166-1/3166-2 jurisdiction code where the entity is legally registered (e.g. US-DE, GB)

gleif_lei_record.name: legal_form_code
gleif_lei_record.description: GLEIF Entity Legal Form (ELF) code identifying the legal structure (ISO 20275)

gleif_lei_record.name: legal_form_name
gleif_lei_record.description: Human-readable name of the legal form (e.g. Limited Liability Company, Public Limited Company)

gleif_lei_record.name: registered_address_line
gleif_lei_record.description: Street address lines of the entity’s registered legal address, newline-separated

gleif_lei_record.name: registered_address_city
gleif_lei_record.description: City of the registered legal address

gleif_lei_record.name: registered_address_country
gleif_lei_record.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the registered legal address

gleif_lei_record.name: registered_address_postal
gleif_lei_record.description: Postal/ZIP code of the registered legal address

gleif_lei_record.name: hq_address_line
gleif_lei_record.description: Street address lines of the entity’s headquarters (may differ from registered address)

gleif_lei_record.name: hq_city
gleif_lei_record.description: City of the headquarters address

gleif_lei_record.name: hq_country
gleif_lei_record.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the headquarters address

gleif_lei_record.name: registration_authority
gleif_lei_record.description: GLEIF Registration Authority (RA) identifier for the body that registered this entity

gleif_lei_record.name: registration_id
gleif_lei_record.description: Entity’s identifier within its registration authority (e.g. company number)

gleif_lei_record.name: lei_status
gleif_lei_record.description: LEI lifecycle status: ISSUED, LAPSED, MERGED, RETIRED, ANNULLED, DUPLICATE, or TRANSFERRED

gleif_lei_record.name: initial_registration
gleif_lei_record.description: Date the LEI was first issued to this entity

gleif_lei_record.name: last_update
gleif_lei_record.description: Date the LEI record was last updated by the managing LOU

gleif_lei_record.name: next_renewal
gleif_lei_record.description: Date by which the entity must renew its LEI to remain ISSUED

gleif_lei_record.name: managing_lou
gleif_lei_record.description: LEI of the Local Operating Unit (LOU) managing this record. References gleif_lei_record.lei.

gleif_relationship.name: child_lei
gleif_relationship.description: LEI of the controlled/subsidiary entity. References gleif_lei_record.lei.

gleif_relationship.name: parent_lei
gleif_relationship.description: LEI of the owning/controlling parent entity. References gleif_lei_record.lei.

gleif_relationship.name: relationship_status
gleif_relationship.description: Status of this relationship record: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, or NULL

gleif_relationship.name: accounting_standard
gleif_relationship.description: Accounting consolidation standard used to determine control: IFRS, US_GAAP, or OTHER

gleif_relationship.name: period_start
gleif_relationship.description: Start date of the reporting period for which this relationship was valid

gleif_relationship.name: period_end
gleif_relationship.description: End date of the reporting period for this relationship (NULL if ongoing)

short_description: Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation — universal business ID used in financial regulation worldwide
long_description: GLEIF (Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation) maintains the LEI (Legal Entity Identifier) system — the universal business identifier mandated by G20 financial regulations. The schema covers LEI records with legal/headquarters addresses, entity status, and corporate ownership hierarchy (parent/child relationships via Level 1/Level 2 data).
when_to_use: Use for any financial application requiring entity identification — KYC compliance, counterparty risk management, transaction reporting, or financial reference data management. LEI codes are required by MiFID II, EMIR, SFTR, and Dodd-Frank for OTC derivatives reporting. Also used for SWIFT payments, Basel reporting, and EU DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) compliance.
